Well, Warren, who was a salesman for him who lived in my neighborhood, Warren brought me down there because I wanted to get me a Zoot Suit. That was my first. So, that's how I got a chance to meet Mr. Silver's because after buying a Zoot Suit, then I bought a couple of other pair of pants down there and bought another suit and whatnot. And the man took a liking to me. He said, hey son, would you like to work? I quit the riverfront and I started selling clothes for him.
